text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, not long before Grass Wonder's debut race…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I head to the training course to get everything set up before Grass Wonder arrives. But when I arrive…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Whew… That'll do.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: All warmed up and ready! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Okay… let's do this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Dashing off with a seemingly effortless burst of blinding speed is Maruzensky, an Umamusume who has earned herself countless epithets.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I've seen her on TV, in magazines, and online plenty of times before, but seeing her run in person… Her form is breathtaking.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Hehe! That was fantabulous!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Since she tends to take an immediate lead in her races, Maruzensky is generally classified as a front runner.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But it seems like less of a conscious strategy, and more that she's so impossibly fast, no one else can get ahead of her.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: All revved up… so now I floor it!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: A fearsome "Beast," through and through. She's well-deserving of the nickname.
choice_data_list: Grass! I didn't know you were here.
Grass! I didn't know you were here.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I just arrived, actually. I'm ready to begin at your earliest convenience.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: We don't have time to waste on gazing in admiration.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Let us focus squarely on our own efforts.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder's fighting spirit burns bright and never wavers, not even in the presence of the Beast.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I conduct her training with a strengthened sense of purpose to help get her to the very top.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On another day…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder joins a scrimmage with other Umamusume scheduled to debut the same time as her.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Pant…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: W-wow… Grass's acceleration is incredible!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Talk about scary.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: When she gets that "gotcha!" look in her eyes, Grass is the last person I want to be up against…

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Really? That look gets me fired up!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, most of us aren't masochists, unlike you.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Qué dices?!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Only 200 left! Grass is leading!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff… huff…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder leaves the rest of the competition in the dust and takes first place.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: 1,600 meters of turf in just a minute and thirty-four seconds… It's hard to believe this is the work of a junior-year racer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The reporters who came to the scrimmage also take notice of Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Hooooly moly… Fantastic! What was her name again?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: It's Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I couldn't be happier seeing you enjoy this scrimmage between the up-and-coming Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Oh, Symboli Rudolf! I was able to capture so many great pictures today! Especially of that last runner!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Who in this generation has the most potential in your eyes?

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Well, it goes without saying that every Umamusume has a great deal of potential.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: For one, there's El Condor Pasa. She proudly claims to be the world's strongest racer, and makes an inspiring amount of effort to keep improving.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Then there's Seiun Sky. She tends to stay out of the spotlight, but once she's on the track, you see just how many tricks are up her sleeve.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Another one of note is Special Week. Despite the challenges she seems to be facing adjusting to her new surroundings, no one can deny the brilliance of her skill.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Mhm! Right, right! Those names have all come up a lot recently!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: I'm sure they have. But let's not forget Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Oh! The Umamusume from the race just now! Which reminds me…

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: One minute and thirty-four seconds over a distance of 1600 meters… That's the same as a certain record performance at the Asahi Hai F.S.!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Surely nobody could see that time and not be reminded of the legendary Beast, Maruzensky!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Yes… Now that you mention it, the similarities are quite the remarkable coincidence.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! And you know what that means?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder could be the next Maruzensky! You could even go so far as to call her the "Beast's Successor"!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Graaass! Great race! Your time was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: …Grass?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Spe.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: The… "Beast's Successor," you say?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I sure do! Everyone in the media booth was saying so after seeing her race today! She's got what it takes to live up to those expectations!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Maruzensky is so dominant that just saying her name brings so many legendary moments to mind.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: And just between us, it was precisely that "Hot Rod" who inspired me to become a huge Umamusume fan!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Quite understandable.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Not only is she undefeated, but in just eight races since her debut, she achieved an unprecedented sum of 61 lengths in their combined margins of victory.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: That commanding lead has inspired people to refer to her races as "solo journeys," giving her such an intimidating reputation…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …it's even resulted in Umamusume withdrawing from their scheduled races just because they know Maruzensky will be entering.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: I know, right?! I heard they almost had to cancel a race 'cause there weren't enough participants!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: It's good that it didn't come to that, but even so… The fact that she's never found herself in a race with a double-digit racer count is a crazy feat in its own right!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: That's why people started calling her the Beast in the first place… But now, Grass Wonder has entered the picture!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: …Hmm.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: She's already this strong, and she hasn't even debuted yet! Heck, she hasn't even been scouted yet!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: And what's more, she's got that unshakable serene confidence! She makes her wins look so effortless, other racers can't hope to compete!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: She's right up there with Maruzensky! I think the Beast's Successor would be the perfect nickname for her!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: You make an intriguing point.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: As you might surmise from my naming her as an example, I also have high hopes for Grass Wonder.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But I say that because…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Hey Grass, are you going back to the dorm after this? We could go togeth—

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Sorry, Spe, but I can't.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'm going to drop by the gym, so please go on ahead without me.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: H… huh?! You're going to the gym at this hour?!

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: But I say that because…

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text: Grass Wonder herself carries unyielding determination to reach the top.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: …The Beast's Successor.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I should feel honored to be mentioned in the same breath as her. But…

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: The title of "Successor" isn't suitable for one who stands at the top.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I could never be content with it.
